errors.evidence: The data point corresponding to the peak of the historical data (at roughly 300,000 on the x-axis) is visibly just below the 310 ppm line, making its value approximately 305-308 ppm. Describing it as "около 300 ppm" is a significant underestimation of the peak value.

The description transcribes a label on the x-axis as '300,300'. This is a literal transcription of a poorly rendered label which is clearly intended to be '300,000', as it falls sequentially between 400,000 and 200,000. This is a misinterpretation of a graphical artifact as a literal value.
